responsibility: Implements Rust metadata lookup and stream-based import input over files, objects, archives, and raw .rox metadata files. It manages the compiler search path, resolves import names through GCC-style path and suffix probing, distinguishes object files, standalone metadata files, and archives, extracts export data from object sections via rust_read_export_data, and supplies the base Import and Stream behaviors plus the file-backed stream implementation used by metadata readers.
same_name_distinction: Implements the runtime side of metadata discovery and input: search-path handling, filename and suffix probing, object/archive/raw-.rox detection, extraction of export sections, and the file-backed stream behavior. Unlike the header, this file contains the concrete package-opening and stream-reading logic rather than the abstract import/stream declarations.
